caption: An egg is cracked on the rim of a bowl and the shell pulled apart above it, and the yolk and white drop into the bowl.

sa.check: An egg is cracked on the rim of a bowl.
The shell is pulled apart above the bowl.
The yolk and white drop into the bowl.
The bowl stays below the shell throughout.
The crack comes first, then the shell opens, then the contents fall.

pc.expect: The contents leave the shell downward as soon as it opens and land in the bowl below.
pc.fail: The contents stay suspended between the shell halves after the shell is open; or they rise out of the shell; or they drift sideways past the bowl.

pc.expect: The white runs as a thick, stringy liquid and the yolk keeps its rounded blob shape until it lands.
pc.fail: The contents pour out as thin water; or the yolk breaks apart like a brittle solid before it lands; or the white holds a rigid shape in the air.

pc.expect: The shell is brittle: it cracks and comes apart in pieces rather than bending.
pc.fail: The shell stretches like rubber as it is pulled apart; or it flows like a liquid; or the crack closes and the shell becomes whole again.

pc.expect: What leaves the shell arrives in the bowl: the pool inside grows as the contents land.
pc.fail: The contents fall into the bowl and the bowl stays empty; or a pool appears in the bowl before the shell opens; or the shell empties with nothing arriving below.

pc.expect: One egg's contents fall, and nothing passes through the bowl.
pc.fail: A second yolk appears; or the contents pass through the bottom of the bowl; or the shell halves merge back into an uncracked egg.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The yolk's colour, the bowl and the worktop stay the same.
pc.fail: The yolk changes colour as it falls; or the bowl changes size or pattern between frames; or the worktop behind rearranges.
